_description.summary: User interface and visuals: icons and markers on the map, draw text, rectangle and line, speck (floating pattern) control, shader vision, hotbar and key or mouse input reflections, telepathy, news and chat display, sounds and particles, Animated Scroll ink.
use_cases: Drawing icons, text or shapes on screen or map

glow_scroll.d: Causes the ink of an Animated Scroll to brightly glow, regardless of lighting conditions.

conjure_speck.d: Conjures a speck with the iota, position, and rotation. Costs a negligible amount of media. Pushes the speck iota to the stack.

move_specklike.d: Moves a speck entity to the position.

rotate_specklike.d: Rotates a speck entity to face the vector.

roll_specklike.d: Accepts a number between 0 and 1, representing a fraction of a full rotation, and rotates the speck's image by that amount.

size_specklike.d: Scales the speck, can range from 0 to 10. Represents size in blocks and is zero by default.

thickness_specklike.d: Changes the stroke thickness of a pattern speck, can range from 0 to 10. Represents twentieths of a block, and is zero by default.

lifetime_specklike.d: Commands the speck to disappear after that many twentieths of a second.

get_chat.d: Applies News Reflection to the last up to 32 messages in chat, wraps each in a list, and pushes a list of those lists.

get_window_size.d: Returns the full width and height of my vision as a vector.

get_icons.d: Pushes a list of the indices of all the Icons I have. This appears as a list of numbers.

draw_text.d: Takes an index, a position, a number, and any iota. Conjures an Icon displaying that iota.

draw_rect.d: Takes an index, a position, a size, and a color. Conjures an Icon displaying that rectangle.

draw_line.d: Takes an index, a position, a size, and a color. Conjures an Icon that joins between the two with a thin line.

rotate_icon.d: Takes an index and an amount of rotation counterclockwise in terms of a full circle. Rotates the icon.

scale_icon.d: Takes an index and a scaling factor. Scales the icon.
